messages.author: Malinok
messages.text: I am confused.  When I was small there where no targets.  I briefly saw 3 targets once when I looked.  The day I was raided there was no targets.  After the raid there was around 6-8 targets and now I have 4.  Is this feature working?  If I can't see targets how are others seeing me?

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text:
<@176063647880052737> the target list is working, it just moves a lot. how it works: your strength = population/1000 + your units. targets are nations at 75%-133% of that, recalculated live every time you open the page.
your numbers right now (10-11):
- population 106.07M -> 106,070 + 11,861 soldiers = about 117.9k strength
- your window: 88.4k to 156.8k
- in range: South Appalachia 150.9k, Chelovka 145.6k, Lerslen 140.0k, Aurelia 138.6k (that is your 4)
- just outside: Maignalis 190k (too strong), celess mob 87.6k (a hair too weak)
nations bunch up right on both edges of your window, so a small change in your pop/army or theirs (growth, losses, building units) pushes them in or out. that is why you saw 0, then 3, then 6-8, then 4. it is the same for everyone looking at you: you show up for anyone whose own window includes 117.9k.
